build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: The player is dealt 8 cards from a standard deck and selects up to 5 to form a poker hand. Selected cards are visually highlighted. Submitting the hand evaluates it as a poker hand type (pair, two pair, straight, flush, full house, etc.) with the hand name displayed. Remaining cards can be discarded and redrawn (limited discards per round). Score 0 if there is no card selection, if hands are not evaluated as poker types, or if there is no discard mechanic.

Each poker hand type has a base chip value and multiplier. Scoring animates sequentially: base chips appear, then each modifier (from Jokers, enhancements) applies visibly one at a time, building the total with dramatic escalation. The final score is compared against the round's blind target. Score 0 if scoring is instant with no animation, if there are no base values per hand type, or if modifiers do not apply visibly.

Each round has a blind target score. The player has multiple hands per round to meet it. Failing to reach the blind ends the run. Blinds escalate: Small Blind, Big Blind, Boss Blind with increasing targets. Boss Blinds have special debuff conditions (e.g., face-down cards, no discards). Score 0 if there is no blind system, if the run cannot end in failure, or if Boss Blinds have no special conditions.

At least 8 distinct Joker cards with unique rule-bending effects and illustrated art. Jokers occupy up to 5 slots and their effects are described in tooltip text. Joker synergies create exponential scoring potential. Score 0 if there are fewer than 8 Jokers, if Jokers have no art, or if their effects are not described.

A shop between rounds sells Jokers, card enhancements (foil, holographic, polychrome with scoring bonuses), and booster packs. Items have prices and the player spends earned money. The shop has at least 3 item categories. Score 0 if there is no shop, if items cannot be purchased, or if fewer than 3 categories exist.

At least 3 Boss Blind conditions that meaningfully change strategy (e.g., all clubs face-down, no discards, first hand debuffed, random cards destroyed). Each Boss Blind is announced with its condition before the round begins. Score 0 if there are fewer than 3 Boss conditions, if conditions are not announced, or if they have no gameplay effect.

Card enhancements visually modify playing cards (foil shimmer, holographic rainbow, polychrome glow) and add scoring bonuses. Enhanced cards are visually distinct from normal cards. At least 3 enhancement types exist. Score 0 if there are no enhancements, if enhanced cards look identical to normal ones, or if fewer than 3 types exist.

The play screen clearly shows: dealt cards, selected hand, current score vs blind target, remaining hands and discards, Joker slots with effects, and money. All elements are readable and non-overlapping at 1280x720. Score 0 if any core element is missing or unreadable.

The scoring animation is clear and dramatic: chips accumulate visibly, multipliers apply with visual emphasis (scale, colour change), and the running total updates in real time. The player can follow exactly how their score was calculated. Score 0 if scoring is instant, if the calculation is not shown step-by-step, or if the total appears without animation.

The full game loop is connected: Title -> Start run -> Play hands -> Score vs blind -> Shop between rounds -> Boss blind -> Win or lose -> Run summary. The player can experience every node without restarting. Score 0 if any transition in the chain is missing or broken.

A title screen is present and styled: it shows the game name in a custom or themed font, has at minimum a play button that is interactive and transitions to the game, and uses a non-default background (casino felt, card artwork, or noir aesthetic) — not plain plain grey or a solid-colour fill. Score 0 if the game launches directly into gameplay with no title screen, or if the start button is non-functional. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Overall art-style coherence: every visible element — playing cards, Jokers, shop items, UI panels, scoring effects — belongs to a single consistent visual language. The palette is casino-noir themed (greens, golds, deep reds); no clashing styles. Score 0 if the screen mixes incompatible styles, or if elements are obviously unthemed placeholder shapes.

Playing cards have illustrated faces with suit symbols and rank; Joker cards have unique illustrated art per Joker; the shop has a themed backdrop; UI panels use styled widgets with custom fonts; scoring effects use authored particle art. Score 0 if cards are plain text, if Jokers have no art, or if UI is unstyled defaults.

Animation continuity and polish: card dealing, card selection highlight, hand submission, scoring cascade, Joker trigger effects, shop transitions, blind announcements, and screen changes each play as smooth multi-frame tweens or sprite animations. No element snaps to its new state in a single frame. Transitions use fades or slides. Score 0 if any of these moments is instantaneous, or if transitions are hard cuts.
